Let $k = \lfloor \log_2 n \rfloor$. Then $k = j$ exactly when $2^j \le n \le 2^{j+1}-1$, which gives $2^j$ integers for each $j$.

Since $2^{11} = 2048 > 2009$, the possible values of $k$ are $0$ through $10$. The odd values are $k = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9$, and each block lies entirely below 2009:

| $k$ | Range of $n$ | Count |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | $[2, 3]$ | 2 |
| 3 | $[8, 15]$ | 8 |
| 5 | $[32, 63]$ | 32 |
| 7 | $[128, 255]$ | 128 |
| 9 | $[512, 1023]$ | 512 |

Total: $2 + 8 + 32 + 128 + 512 = 682$.

ANSWER: 682
